_readme: 'pads' rows are [pad, board_pin, net, line]: pad is the number OpenTac-CAD writes in a manifest's rp/cp; board_pin is the readout board connector pin it reaches (the cable mirrors the connector, pin = N + 1 - pad); net is that pin's net on the board; line 0-31 is the shift-register step that drives it, 32-63 is mux channel line-32 that reads it.
title: 30-pin board (two stacked boards)
connector: Molex 505110-3091, 30 pins on the bottom board: pins 1-15 = c1..c15 (sensed), 16-30 = r1..r15 (driven)
checked: hardware and netlist. Pads 7-24 measured on the 9x9 square skin (2026-09-11); the netlist gives the same map for all pads 1-30.
